title: Tech Note: Creating a Search Bar with Dropdown List
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The described technique (QUERY-driven search combined with a selection-based dropdown list box, manual arrow-key handling) is a classic-mode pattern using array/selection-based records rather than ORDA. It is still functional in current 4D, but a developer building this today would more likely implement it using ORDA entity selections/collections and a collection-based list box, consistent with 4D's broader post-v16 shift away from classic table selections.
related_updates: ORDA entity/collection-based list boxes are now the preferred data source for new development over classic selection-based list boxes
The core UX pattern (dropdown-as-you-type search) remains valid and common; only the underlying data access layer has shifted
